title: Vattanac Golf Resort Comparing East and West Courses
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Vattanac Golf Resort, a 36-hole complex 45 minutes from Phnom Penh, features two distinct Faldo Design courses: the East Course (Heritage) with scale models of Pre-Angkorean structures like Angkor Wat and Preah Vihear Temple on the 7th hole, and the West Course (The Specialist), opened in late 2020, characterized by Dragon Lake and narrower, tree-lined fairways.
> *   The East Course offers expansive, undulating fairways and large, tiered greens, catering to "The Visionary" who appreciates scale, while the West Course presents narrower, technical doglegs and smaller, firm greens, designed for "The Tactician" seeking precision.
> *   Managed by Troon Golf, Vattanac Golf Resort will feature one of Southeast Asia's largest clubhouses in 2026, including a VIP Wing with private dining and a pro shop, with mandatory GPS-equipped carts providing precise yardages.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

**Vattanac Golf Resort: Comparing the East and West Courses**

**Comparative Design Matrix**

| Metric | The East Course (Heritage) | The West Course (The Specialist) | 
|---|---|---|
| Core Theme | Cultural Iconography & Grandeur | Technical Precision & Intimacy | 
| Signature Features | Scale models of [Angkor Wat](https://whc.unesco.org/) & Bayon | Dragon Lake & King Jayavarman VII Statues | 
| Fairway Profile | Expansive, undulating mounding | Narrower, tree-lined, technical doglegs | 
| Greens | Large, tiered, high-receptive | Smaller, firm, heavily guarded by sand | 
| Player Type | The Visionary (Appreciates Scale) | The Tactician (Appreciates Precision) | 

**Phnom Penh: The New Frontier of Asian Golf**

For the refined traveler, **Vattanac Golf Resort** represents the "New [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/)." Located just 45 minutes from the center of Phnom Penh, this 36-hole complex is managed by Troon Golf, ensuring a level of hospitality that rivals the best clubs in Dubai or Scottsdale. Both courses were designed by [Faldo Design](https://nickfaldodesign.com/), but they offer diametrically opposed experiences.

**The East Course: A Walk Through History**

The East Course is arguably the most unique "theme" course in the world. It integrates scale models of Pre-Angkorean structures directly into the strategy of the holes. On the **7th hole**, you approach a green framed by a replica of the **Preah Vihear Temple**. This isn't just aesthetic; the structures provide unique aiming points and psychological pressure. The East is a "Big" course—the fairways are generous, but the water features are massive. It is designed for the player who loves to use their driver but requires a soft touch on the large, multi-tiered greens.

**The West Course: Navigating the Dragon**

The West Course, opened in late 2020, offers a more "secluded" feel. It is defined by **Dragon Lake**, which sits at the heart of the layout. The fairways here are narrower and more undulating than the East. Technically, the West is a "shot-maker's" course. It requires you to shape the ball off the tee to find the correct side of the fairway for an open approach shot. The greens are smaller and demand higher accuracy; a "green in regulation" on the West is a hard-earned victory.

**VIP Facilities for the 2026 Season**

In 2026, Vattanac boasts one of the largest and most luxurious clubhouses in Southeast Asia. For the refined traveler, the "VIP Wing" offers private dining suites and a pro shop stocked with exclusive, high-end European brands. The GPS-equipped carts are mandatory, providing precise yardages to the "hidden" pin positions that the resort is famous for.

_Experience the duality of Cambodia's premier 36-hole resort._ **_Let Asia Golf Specialists curate your ultimate Phnom Penh golf escape._**

## Day vs. Floodlit Night Golf & Transfer Logistics From Rosewood Phnom Penh
Both 18-hole championship courses at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/) sit 40 minutes northeast of central Phnom Penh via private luxury MPV from [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) and [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/). Because both the [Vattanac East Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-east/) (Par 72, 7,469 yards) and [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/) (Par 72, 7,249 yards) are equipped with tournament-grade LED floodlighting, touring groups on [The Khmer Kingdom Links](/tours/the-khmer-kingdom-links/) frequently play the East Course at 07:30 AM to admire the scale replicas of Angkor Wat, Bayon, and Preah Vihear in morning sunlight, then book a 3:00 PM twilight-into-night tee time on the West Course the following day to play around Dragon Lake in 25°C evening comfort.

faqs.q: Should our group play the East Course or West Course first at Vattanac Golf Resort in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: We recommend opening with the 7,469-yard East Course for its dramatic scale replicas of Angkor Wat, Bayon, and Preah Vihear and wider landing areas, then tackling the tighter, water-framed 7,249-yard West Course around Dragon Lake on Day 2.

faqs.q: Does Vattanac Golf Resort offer floodlit night golf in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Yes. Vattanac Golf Resort features state-of-the-art championship floodlighting across both Nick Faldo layouts, allowing groups to tee off at 3:00 PM in golden-hour light and finish 18 holes in cooler evening temperatures.

faqs.q: How far is Vattanac Golf Resort from Rosewood Phnom Penh and Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: Vattanac Golf Resort is a 40-minute chauffeured transfer from Rosewood Phnom Penh and Raffles Hotel Le Royal, and pairs naturally in a 3-round Phnom Penh rotation alongside Brian Curley's Chhun On Golf Resort and Garden City Golf Club.
